Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified Square Enix as the developer of the game in the updated understanding section of step 2. Square Enix is the publisher, while Crystal Dynamics is the actual developer of Tomb Raider (2013). This misunderstanding led to confusion in subsequent steps, where the focus was on verifying the publisher instead of the developer.
